notes: Replaces hdri_industrial_dusk, which measured as a sunset but rendered as a midday blue sky: its warm wedge had a MEDIAN height of 0 deg and covered only 35% of the horizon arc, so from the spawn sightline the frame showed nothing but the cool anti-sun hemisphere. This plate is warm across 100% of the arc with a median warm-wedge height of 23.3 deg (70.8% of the arc stays warm to at least 15 deg), which is what lets the key light be raked up to a playable elevation without the sky contradicting it. PNGs losslessly recompressed on install; pixels are bit-identical to the library originals.

measured_sun.convention: azimuth measured from -Z toward +X; elevation = asin(y)
